outcome: Need for admission to neonatal unit
cohort: 497 women with dichorionic diamniotic twin pregnancies
finding: In dichorionic diamniotic twin pregnancies, assisted conception was not significantly associated with adverse obstetric and perinatal outcomes compared to spontaneous conception.
mod_finding: Women who conceived twins via assisted conception and did not have an elective caesarean section were more likely to experience spontaneous labor and had a higher risk of estimated blood loss exceeding 1L compared to those who conceived naturally.
